description: Erection of a 2-storey side extension and a redesign of the front porch.
decision_conditions: Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the rear elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

<p style="padding:3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt 3.0pt">The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the submitted Planning Statement: Tree Protection Measures document. The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.&nbsp; &nbsp;Nothing shall be stored or placed&nbsp; in any area fenced in accordance with this condition, and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.</p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
